svg.text: Bench layout: what it looks like on the table
Half size breadboard above, PocketBeagle 2 below with its P1 header facing the breadboard (USB-C to the left). Module pin order is the common one; read your own silkscreen.
these five holes are joined inside the board. the + and - rails run the whole length.
the groove splits top half from bottom half. nothing is used below the groove here.
beagleboard.org (upside down: the board is turned so P1 faces the breadboard)

Four long jumpers leave P1: pin 14 to the + rail, pin 15 to the - rail, pin 26 to the SDA column, pin 28 to the SCL column. Short jumpers on the breadboard: each module VCC to +, GND to -, SDA to the SDA column, SCL to the SCL column.
